name: 53092 · Mequon, WI
findings: ZIP 53092 (Mequon) has 143 nonprofit organizations. 53 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 48 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53092 (Mequon) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 53092 (Mequon) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.9 times the typical level).

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 33 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
